newsitem.title: USA: Spain's Telefonica to join Concert-sources.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Telefonica to join Concert-sources.

text.p: Telefonica de Espana on Friday is to announce it will join the Concert alliance of merger partners British Telecommunications Plc and MCI Communications Corp., sources close to the deal said Thursday.

They said that British Telecom will take a minority stake in Telefonica and added the Spanish company is expected eventually to leave its Unisource alliance with AT&T Corp. and three other European telecom companies.
"The announcement will be made on Friday from Madrid," one of the sources said, declining to be identified.
